Complete this story about a journey using the past simple passive or past continuous passive form of the verbs in the brackets.

My journey to Kuakata was painful. First of all, I was late to get up from my bed. I ____________ (take) to the bus stop by a rickshaw but the rickshaw ____________ (stick) in traffic jam because the road ____________ (repair). When I got to the bus stand , I ____________ (tell) that there was a problem and the bus would be late. When the bus came I ____________ (give) a seat beside some noisy young boys and girls. During the journey all through the passengers ____________ (entertain) with some cheap music and video. Suddenly the bus ____________ (stop) by some policemen and it ____________ (check) thoroughly. It took nearly half an hour. I was inwardly burning. When I arrived at Kuakata after evening, it was raining. I went to hotel where some other tourists were waiting too. We ____________ (charge) higher than the regular tariff. However, finally I ____________ (take) to a room. The door ____________ (unlock) by the porter and I was happy to see the tidy room. I just threw myself in the bed.
